Application Data.NAME: Heritage Library and Museum
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: The Heritage Library and Museum provides a wide range of educational and cultural resources to the community, focusing on the preservation and public accessibility of historical documents and artifacts. Our operations include lending services, special exhibitions, educational programs, and community outreach initiatives. Additionally, we host a limited number of events featuring refreshments that do not include alcohol, ensuring compliance with our risk management protocols. The facility has robust security measures in place, including a part-time security guard and a state-of-the-art fire suppression system, to safeguard our valuable collections. Our commitment to the preservation of cultural heritage is reflected in our controlled environment for artifacts, with regular appraisals conducted to maintain accurate valuation for insurance purposes. Furthermore, we are exploring the integration of digital platforms for ticketing and educational content, with enhanced cyber risk management strategies in place to mitigate any potential online threats.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On April 12, 2023, the Heritage Library and Museum experienced water damage to a section of the rare book collection due to a burst pipe. The estimated cost of restoration and preserving the affected materials was $5,000. The incident has been resolved with no ongoing claims or disputes.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: High-Security Grade II Safe - UL Listed, secure storage for artifacts and valuable collections.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Part-time security guard, surveillance cameras, and fencing to deter unauthorized access. Regular security audits conducted to assess effectiveness and address vulnerabilities.
